description: READ-ONLY: list recent execution fills on a CEX connection (individual order executions with price/qty/fee, spot + futures). Never moves funds, never writes Diary rows — fills are Activity history (see read_closed_pnl for realized PnL). Unimplemented venues return an empty list; a venue walk that exceeds its time budget fails loud, never truncated-as-empty.

connectionId.description: CEX connection id (see list_connections). Takes precedence over exchange.

exchange.description: CEX slug, e.g. kucoin (resolved to an active connection; connectionId wins when both are given)

name: list_fills
title: List CEX execution fills
